title: FilNav
tagline: Find and compare the best decentralized storage providers on the Filecoin network with our easy-to-use tool. Discover providers based on your specific needs and ensure your data is in safe hands with our reputation and QoS systems.
description: A credibility assessment platform that allows users to sort through different storage provider options and select the best match for them. Each storage provider will have a profile that includes any verifiable documentation that helps prove their quality and reputation to potential clients. We want to help make web3 storage safer and more transparent.
how_its_made:
We used the following technologies and languages:

Languages: Solidity, Python, JavaScript
Oracle: ChainLink
Compute: Spheron, Google Cloud Functions, Bacalhau (just testing)
Data Storage: IPFS/Filecoin, MongoDB (Spheron Compute)
No-Code Tools: Retool (front-end), Huddle (With Cal.com)
Design: Adobe Illustrator (logo)
